long_biography.plain_text:
Mistry inherited leadership of a business whose origins lie in construction. His father, Pallonji Mistry, handed him the chairmanship in 2012. Under Shapoor, the group has remained active across engineering, infrastructure, real estate, water, energy and finance. Current leadership pages name him chairman and his son Pallon as president of corporate affairs.

The family's largest disclosed asset is its minority holding in Tata Sons, not direct ownership of Tata operating companies. After Pallonji died in June 2022 and Shapoor's younger brother Cyrus died that September, Shapoor became the senior figure overseeing the family enterprise. He has continued a restructuring that includes asset sales and preparing a younger generation, including his son and Cyrus's sons, for governance and capital-allocation roles.

uncertainties: The dedicated Forbes profile is verified, but its current net-worth estimate, list rank and Tata Group revenue are volatile and are excluded from both biographies.

Several closely related Mistry names create a generation risk. The target is Shapoor Pallonji Mistry, born in September 1964, who received the SP Group chairmanship in 2012. He is not his father Pallonji Shapoorji Mistry, who died in June 2022; his younger brother Cyrus Pallonji Mistry, who died in September 2022; his son Pallon Shapoor Mistry; or the earlier family businessman Shapoorji Mistry.

The Companies House officer page uses Shapoorji Mistry while SP filings use Shapoor Pallonji Mistry or Shapoor P Mistry. Exact company, Mumbai address, Irish nationality, birth month and active director role establish that this is a formal name variant for the resolved chairman, not a separate namesake.

Forbes lists Mumbai, India as residence, while the active UK Companies House filing lists Monaco as country of residence. Both are strong sources but measure residence differently and conflict, so neither main nor secondary residence is proposed.

No sufficiently authoritative source was found for an exact birth day or birth country. September 1964 is proposed from Companies House and corroborated by Forbes's age, but residence, citizenship and Indian business roots do not establish birthplace.
Irish citizenship is independently supported by Forbes and Companies House. No second nationality is proposed because no reliable current source establishes one.

Forbes describes the fortune as shared with the family of late younger brother Cyrus. The dossier does not assign Shapoor a personal percentage of the SP Group, family holding companies or Tata Sons stake and does not collapse Cyrus's heirs' interests into his own.

The Mistry family's 18.4% interest is in Tata Sons, the Tata Group holding company. It is not represented as Shapoor's direct ownership of Tata Consultancy Services, Tata Motors, Tata Steel, Tata Power or other operating companies, nor as control of Tata Group.

The SP Group website describes 15 major companies, six business segments, projects, workforce and global operations. These are corporate or group attributes, not Shapoor's directly held personal assets, revenue, employees or projects.

Pallonji Mistry expanded the group, acquired strategic companies and historically held the Tata Sons interest before handing over the chairmanship. Those achievements support the inherited origin and family history but are not reassigned to Shapoor.

Shapoor is the active group chairman, but official leadership names Akhil Gupta as the separate engineering and construction chief executive and Pallon Mistry as president of corporate affairs. The biography does not call Shapoor day-to-day chief executive of every group company.

Economic Times reports that son Pallon and nephews Firoz and Zahan are being prepared for governance and capital-allocation roles without current profit-and-loss responsibility. They are not described as current co-chairmen, operators of all group businesses or owners of Shapoor's personal stake.

The family's debt, refinancing, collateral and asset-sale proceeds belong to the relevant promoters, holding companies or operating entities. They are not represented as Shapoor's personal debt, cash flow or directly owned assets.

The immutable mortality status Alive agrees with current Forbes, company leadership, Companies House and 2025 reporting. Death dates belong to Pallonji and Cyrus only and are not proposed for Shapoor.
No verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram or standalone personal website was found. The official group website is proposed as a Company Website, not as Shapoor's personal site.
